title.en: KV-cache lineage: MHA, MQA, GQA, and MLA
title.zh: KV 缓存谱系：MHA、MQA、GQA 和 MLA

en.a: The KV cache is a memory term in the decoder path; sharing heads reduces repeated K/V state, and latent compression reduces it further while preserving the score and value paths.
en.b: Every variant still defines a prefix-conditioned attention distribution. MQA and GQA share cached K/V representations, while MLA changes the cached representation and uses algebraic absorption only where the indices permit it.

zh.a: KV 缓存是解码器路径中的一个内存术语；共享头可以减少重复的 K/V 状态，而潜在压缩可以进一步减少它，同时保留分数和价值路径。
zh.b: 每个变体仍然定义了一个前缀条件注意力分布。MQA 和 GQA 共享缓存的 K/V 表示，而 MLA 改变了缓存的表示，并且仅在索引允许的地方使用代数吸收。
